candidates.title: 7 takeaways from the Carney government's 2nd budget
candidates.description: The 2026 federal budget outlines billions in new spending, but mostly on non-permanent measures. Here are some takeaways.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: From gas to groceries, how much is in the federal budget for your wallet?
candidates.description: The 2026 budget increases payments for the Canada Groceries and Essentials Benefit and expands a tax credit for low-wage workers. But the affordability measures are mostly for the short term, and took a back seat to measures aimed at boosting investment.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: 15 patients released, 5 still hospitalized following bus crash near Mackenzie, B.C.
candidates.description: WorkSafeBC and RCMP are still investigating what police described as a "chaotic scene" when the shuttle bus went off Highway 39, causing hospitals in Prince George and Mackenzie to declare a code orange.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Post-secondary students across Ontario walk out of classrooms to protest OSAP changes, tuition hike
candidates.description: University and college students across Ontario are protesting rising tuition fees and the province's cuts to the Ontario Student Assistance Program in a provincewide walkout Thursday.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Men involved in Old Montreal fire that killed 2 plead guilty to reduced manslaughter charge
candidates.description: Two young men pleaded guilty to a reduced charge of manslaughter for their involvement in an Old Montreal building fire that killed a woman and her daughter in October 2024.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: U.S. midterms are a 'vindication' of Alberta's approach to tariffs, says Premier Smith
candidates.description: Alberta Premier Danielle Smith says sweeping Democrat wins in the U.S. midterm elections prove her province was on the right path in the cross-border trade war.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: How will a resounding U.S. political shift impact the cross-border auto industry?
candidates.description: In Michigan, it's believed U.S. President Donald Trump's tariffs played a big role with midterm election voters. Here's what auto industry members and business interests are saying about how the results may impact cross-border relations.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: 'Survivors are coming in hungry': Survey on Canada's shelters sees gender-based violence, food insecurity link
candidates.description: A national survey of women’s shelters and transition houses has found 96 per cent of respondents say their communities face a food security crisis. The report, by Women’s Shelters Canada, examined the link between gender-based violence and food insecurity, and how the affordability crisis has affected shelters and those using them.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Ontario doctors demand apology from province for letters flagging high number of days worked, patients seen
candidates.description: The Ontario Medical Association is looking for an apology from the province, after it says 'hundreds' of doctors received letters recently stating they were working too many days or seeing too many patients. A health ministry spokesperson says the letters are not an assumption of inappropriate billing.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Shell drives spike in oil exploration bids off the coast of Newfoundland
candidates.description: Newfoundland and Labrador's offshore energy regulator says Shell, the London-headquartered company, successfully bid on six exploration licenses off the province's east and southeast coast.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Telus says 'small number' of calls interrupted in Eastern Canada on Thursday
candidates.description: An outage map on the Telus website showed issues with phone and wireless services in several provinces on Thursday.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Pediatrician accused of uploading illicit video of young girl remained licensed for months
candidates.description: Toronto police applications to obtain search warrants obtained by CBC reveal that a tip from Dropbox led to the investigation into 45-year-old Dr. Dilan Dissanayake, who has since been charged with possessing and accessing child sexual abuse and exploitation material.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Russian hacker group claims to have posted B.C. school district information on dark web
candidates.description: CBC News has discovered a hacked database stolen from the Burnaby School District on a dark web site run by a prominent shadowy ransomware group believed to be operating out of Russia.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Unmanaged menopause symptoms cost Canada's economy $3.5B, experts tell MPs
candidates.description: Unmanaged menopause symptoms are not just impacting women, but costing the Canadian economy $3.5 billion and 540,000 lost workdays every year, according to the Menopause Foundation of Canada.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Motorcade honours B.C. soldier killed in fire at CFB Wainwright
candidates.description: Pte. Aidan Goulding from North Vancouverwas among four soldiers killed in the blaze that overwhelmed a live-fire training exercise at CFB Wainwright on Oct. 17.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Alberta's governing UCP endorses proposed riding boundary changes as NDP reiterates concerns
candidates.description: Alberta's governing United Conservatives have officially endorsed changes to provincial riding boundaries that the Opposition NDP says it believes are “rigged” to help the UCP win the next election.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Now-retired senior military officer denies sex assault allegation as Winnipeg trial wraps up
candidates.description: A retired military lieutenant-colonel accused of sexual assault in Winnipeg vehemently denied the allegations against her during testimony Wednesday, as her trial concluded with the prosecution urging a judge to convict her.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Beach weather in November? In Canada? These photos prove it
candidates.description: Parts of Ontario and Quebec have been experiencing record-setting temperatures this week, and people have been taking full advantage of it.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: P.E.I. health minister admits doctor recruitment has been 'underwhelming'
candidates.description: There was no ambiguity on the challenges faced in Prince Edward Island's health-care system from the health minister Wednesday.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: California Gov. Gavin Newsom says he'll commute all death row sentences to life in prison
candidates.description: California governor Gavin Newsom is commuting the death sentences of more than 500 inmates to life in prison with no parole, saying he believes state-sanctioned killing is incompatible with the values of California, undermines the foundations of the legal system and "diminishes each of us."
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: AI stock sell-off sends the S&P 500 down 4.4% in worst day since April 2025
candidates.description: AI stocks worldwide felt pressure as worries rise about possible moratoriums on data centres following Democratic victories in the U.S. midterm elections.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Bomb threats affect at least 27 flights, leading to emergency landings at several European airports
candidates.description: A series of hoax ‌bomb threats hit European airlines from Ireland to Bulgaria on Thursday morning for the second time this week, with some of at least 27 affected flights making unplanned landings or being escorted by fighter jets.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Mexican judge arrested over alleged $2M bribe to release Ryan Wedding's second-in-command
candidates.description: A Mexican judge has been arrested on allegations that he accepted a $2-million US bribe in exchange for granting bail to a man accused of acting as second-in-command to Ryan Wedding, the former Canadian Olympic snowboarder turned alleged drug kingpin, American officials said on Thursday.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Ohio and Texas went from red to blue in the midterms but may not stay that way in 2028
candidates.description: The Democrats flipping governorships and Senate seats in Texas and Ohio turned the states dramatically blue on election night. Some political observers say these wins don't necessarily mean the states will stay that colour, but they do reveal a new political reality — that they'll be electoral battlegrounds in the 2028 presidential election.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Melania Trump hosted officials from Russia and Ukraine. Just what's behind her peace push?
candidates.description: As President Donald Trump and his fellow Republicans take stock after a devastating midterm election that saw the Democrats seize control of Congress, his wife Melania is preparing to host representatives who will almost certainly praise Washington's actions.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Largely peaceful marches across France as workers stage strike, some police clashes reported
candidates.description: Some protesters clashed with police in Paris and Lyon on Thursday during largely peaceful nationwide demonstrations and a one-day strike by some public sector workers in a renewed challenge to President Emmanuel Macron.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Prominent Hong Kong activist Joshua Wong sentenced to 10 years in 2nd national security case
candidates.description: Prominent Hong Kong activist Joshua Wong was sentenced to 10 years in prison on Thursday for his second conviction under a Beijing-imposed national security law, in a case that critics say reflects the crackdown on the city's once-thriving pro-democracy movement.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Senior Democratic congressman says party 'going to put an end' to Trump's tariffs
candidates.description: A senior Democrat says his party will work to end U.S. President Donald Trump's tariffs on allies, including Canada, when it takes control of Congress next year.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: NASA's Swift space telescope plunges to Earth after 22 years in orbit
candidates.description: One of NASA's premier space telescopes plunged to Earth on Wednesday, ending its 22-year investigation of gamma ray bursts and exploding stars.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Valkyries celebrate WNBA championship with San Francisco and Oakland fans
candidates.description: Dancing in the streets, popping champagne and high-fiving fans was all part of the celebration on Wednesday as the Golden State Valkyries parade made its way through Oakland and then across the bay in San Francisco.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Trump lost Congress. 3 presidents before him did, too
candidates.description: Donald Trump just joined a rare presidential club of U.S. presidents to lose both the House and Senate in the midterms. CBC's Mike Crawley looks at the former presidents who also faced similar congressional busts. CORRECTION (Nov. 4, 2026): In this video, there is a reference to Donald Trump being the third U.S. president to lose both the House and Senate in the midterms. In fact, he is the fourth.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: JD Vance blames Iran war for midterm thumping. Is he really blaming Trump?
candidates.description: U.S. Vice-President JD Vance blamed the Republican Party's decisive defeat in the midterm elections on the war that President Donald Trump launched against Iran.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Midterms ‘bluenami’: The exact moment Trump lost control of Congress | About That
candidates.description: Democrats made historic gains in the U.S. midterm elections, winning majority control of both the House and Senate by flipping deep-red seats in several states including Texas, South Carolina and Kansas. Andrew Chang breaks down shifts across key battlegrounds to explain how the 'bluenami' unfolded as traditional Republican strongholds fell. (Photo credits: The Canadian Press, Reuters, Adobe Stock and Getty Images)
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Native American women make history in U.S. midterm elections
candidates.description: Deb Haaland and Peggy Flanagan have made history in the U.S. midterm elections, becoming the first Native American woman elected governor and U.S. senator, respectively, marking a milestone for Indigenous political representation in the U.S.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Iranian officials welcome U.S. midterm results after voters rebuke Trump administration, Iran war
candidates.description: Iranian officials celebrated U.S. voters' rebuke of the Republican Party and President Donald Trump in the midterm elections, as the region waited to see how the results could affect the Iran war.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Questions arise over emergency treatment given to Spanish soccer player in fatal collision
candidates.description: While Spain mourns the death of a soccer player who suffered a cardiac arrest after an on-field collision, the emergency medical treatment he received is falling under scrutiny.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Kellogg's Rice Krispies changed its U.K. recipe, muffling its iconic snap, crackle and pop
candidates.description: Some consumers in the U.K. are in an uproar after cereal-maker Kellogg's recently changed its recipe there for Rice Krispies, replacing the whole rice grains in the family-favourite breakfast with rice flour.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Ottawa readies ban on fees for moving investment accounts
candidates.description: The federal government has released draft regulations to stop banks from charging fees when a client moves an investment account to a different financial institution.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Maple Leaf Foods plans to raise prices again early next year, CEO says in earnings call
candidates.description: Maple Leaf raised prices earlier this year to help offset higher costs — the second such price increase in a year — but it hasn't been enough to mitigate rising expenses.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: CBC Money to launch next year with slate of original content dedicated to personal finance
candidates.description: CBC is announcing the launch of CBC Money, a new slate of original content coming next year that will focus on the daily cost-of-living news that matters to Canadians.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: What to watch for as Carney introduces his 2nd federal budget
candidates.description: Prime Minister Mark Carney will deliver his second federal budget on Thursday as the Liberal government reveals next steps in its plan to support the country through an affordability crunch and the trade war.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Is Grand Theft Auto VI the most anticipated video game of all time? Here are some reasons why
candidates.description: The latest in the long-running series of crime simulators by Rockstar Games is predicted to be the biggest release in video game history.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Elon Musk gets little bang for his buck in U.S. midterms, with possible Democratic investigations to come
candidates.description: As Republicans suffered a landslide defeat and Texas elected its first Democratic governor in more than three decades, one of the biggest losers of the U.S. midterms was not on the ballot: billionaire Elon Musk.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Tax and tariff relief top small businesses' wish list for Budget 2026
candidates.description: Small businesses employ some 60 per cent of the private sector workforce, but have been squeezed by tariffs and cash flow issues. After Canada's finance minister foreshadowed that entrepreneurs would see themselves reflected in the budget, they're hopeful the government's plan might bring them some much-needed relief.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Google launches AI-based shopping in Canada in race to dominate e-commerce
candidates.description: Google launched a new online shopping tool in Canada on Wednesday, allowing complete purchases via chat with its AI agent.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Hoax bomb threats target European airlines and airports for second time in a week
candidates.description: At least 21 flights across Europe are affected in what the UK government calls a "malicious hoax threat".
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Who could be behind hoax bomb threats to European air travel?
candidates.description: There is no hard evidence so far linking airline bomb threats to Russia, Iran or any proxy groups.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: French protests see numbers surge as unions join strikes over high cost of living
candidates.description: The interior ministry estimates 600,000 people joined protests across France, while the unions say the number was far higher.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Paraguay President Santiago Peña resigns after bank collapse
candidates.description: The move follows a bank collapse and after the lower house of congress voted in favour of pursuing an impeachment trial against him.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Major tech stocks plunge as US midterms add to fears of AI slowdown
candidates.description: The market has been reacting to possible tougher scrutiny of data centre construction and the AI industry following the US mid-terms
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Melania Trump calls for lasting Ukraine truce as she hosts Russian and Ukrainian officials
candidates.description: The US first lady was credited by all for playing a key though unspecified role in the ceasefire.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Russell Brand is being investigated over two new rape complaints, police say
candidates.description: Det Supt Andy Furphy said he hoped other potential victims would gain "courage" and "confidence" from the guilty verdicts.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: The Pitt and ER are similar enough for lawsuit to proceed, judge rules
candidates.description: The widow of ER creator Michael Crichton argues The Pitt is effectively a reboot of the 1990s series.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: 'I'm not a quitter': Kim Kardashian on retaking the bar exam
candidates.description: The All's Fair star tells the BBC she has not given up, but will be "more quiet" about her journey to become a lawyer.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Vance walks Trump tightrope with scathing election critique blaming Iran war
candidates.description: The vice-president's blunt assessment of Republican election defeat marked one of the sharpest breaks with a sitting president in recent memory.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: A bitter end for Ronaldo - the icon who transformed Portugal
candidates.description: As Cristiano Ronaldo retires from international football, Guillem Balague looks at why and what is next for the Portugal legend.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Why a US-funded vaccine trial on babies was cancelled in Guinea-Bissau
candidates.description: The trial was condemned as "unethical" and "neocolonial" because half of the babies would not be given the vaccine.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline
candidates.description: As South Africans vote in local elections, residents tell the BBC they are tired of the poor quality of services they get.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Typhoons batter East Asia as El Niño makes Pacific 'burn with fever'
candidates.description: Even for countries where typhoons are a way of life, the last few months have brought unusually wild weather.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Russell Brand is convicted of rape, and judge says he'll get a prison term
candidates.description: A prosecutor described Brand as a ruthless, calculating, manipulative "sexual predator." Brand, 51, denied the charges, saying he had never forced anyone to do something against their will.

candidates.title: What's next for Democrats after the midterms. And, a look at the outstanding races
candidates.description: Democrats have regained control of Congress. They have a long list of investigations into Trump planned. And, not all races have been called. Here's a look at how they could affect the Dems' majority.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: Three ways Democrats could reshape U.S. foreign policy after the midterms
candidates.description: On Morning Edition, Pulitzer Prize-winning historian Anne Applebaum breaks down what a Democratic Congress could change about Trump's foreign policy and what remains beyond its power.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: Bob Dylan comes knockin' on pope's door as Leo welcomes legend to Vatican
candidates.description: The American singer-songwriter and poet visited with the American pope at the Vatican during a break between concert dates in Italy. The Vatican said the encounter was brief.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: Hong Kong activist Joshua Wong is sentenced to 10 more years in prison
candidates.description: Wong was sentenced for his second conviction under a Beijing-imposed national security law, in a case that critics say reflects the crackdown on the city's once-thriving pro-democracy movement.

candidates.title: Abdul El-Sayed welcomes Trump's plan to cut Israel aid, calls for end to arms sales
candidates.description: Michigan's first Muslim senator-elect, Abdul El-Sayed, discusses his historic victory, an unlikely agreement with Trump on Israel military aid and the political divisions that remain.

candidates.title: The world is reacting to the Democrats' sweeping midterm elections victory

candidates.title: Democrats seize full control of Congress. And, which candidates made history last night
candidates.description: Democrats have won the House and the Senate, taking full control of Congress for the first time since 2023. And history was made in several states. Here's what happened last night.

candidates.title: Japan faces diplomatic dilemma amid joint pressure from nuclear neighbors
candidates.description: As the Ukraine war grinds on, ties between Russia and neighboring Japan are at their worst in decades. Tokyo wants more support from Washington, but some Japanese are concerned they may not get it.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: First-time homebuyers remain scarce, but a record share of them pay all cash
candidates.description: A new report finds generational wealth is widening the divide between homebuyers and those priced out. The median age of first-time buyers also remains at a record high.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: As budgets tighten, people are breaking out their library cards
candidates.description: Some Americans squeezed by high prices are relying more on their local libraries for things like books, streaming services and high-priced items like musical instruments and sewing machines.

candidates.title: Does the blue wave mean lower gasoline and diesel prices soon? Don't hold your breath
candidates.description: A new Democratic majority in Congress could pressure the president to end the war in Iran. But it will be harder for them to directly affect fuel prices, which are tied to a complex international oil market.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: Legendary photographer on getting that perfect election night picture
candidates.description: On election night, photographers will be in position, ready to snap history-making moments. It's something Pulitzer-prize-winner photographer David Hume Kennerly, has done for decades.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: Teens worldwide aren't getting enough exercise -- especially girls
candidates.description: A new study looks at the recommended amount of daily exercise for adolescents — and how few are getting it.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: It was a big night for doctors to win seats in Congress, riding the blue wave
candidates.description: Historically, most physicians who served in the House or Senate have been Republicans. In the next Congress, physicians who are Democrats made significant gains.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.description: ...RISK FOR RAPID FIRE GROWTH AND EXTREME FIRE BEHAVIOR WITH ANY NEW FIRE STARTS, ESPECIALLY LATE FRIDAY NIGHT THROUGH SATURDAY... .Weak to moderate Santa Ana winds will be on the increase, peaking on Saturday. During the peak, gusts of 30 to 45 mph will be common in the typical wind-prone areas of Los Angeles and Ventura Counties. Meanwhile, the air will warm and dry, with minimum humidities in the 8 to 20 percent range common by Saturday. Fuels remain critically dry despite some minor greenup from recent rains. There is a high risk for fast-moving fires where the plants are driest and the winds are strongest, which this targeted Red Flag Warning addresses. The National Weather Service in Los Angeles/Oxnard has issued a Red Flag Warning for wind and low relative humidity, which is in effect from 2 AM to 6 PM PST Saturday. * AFFECTED AREA...Santa Clarita Valley, Santa Monica Mountains Recreational Area, Santa Susana Mountains and Western San Gabriel Mountains. * TIMING...From 2 AM to 6 PM PST Saturday. * WINDS...Periods of northeast 20 to 30 mph with gusts to 45 mph. Isolated gusts of 45 to 55 mph possible. * RELATIVE HUMIDITY...Minimums of 8 to 20 percent. Poor overnight recoveries. * IMPACTS...If fire ignition occurs, conditions are favorable for extreme fire behavior which would threaten life and property.
